cc:Work.dc:title: ClosedBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Fully closed box
This box is more of a building block than a finished item. Use a vector graphics program (like Inkscape) to add holes or adjust the base plate.
See BasedBox for variant with a base.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes ClosedBox --x=270 --y=80 --h=70 --thickness=4 --burn=0.1 '--output=T:\closedbox.svg' Command line short: boxes ClosedBox --x=270 --y=80 --h=70 --thickness=4 '--output=T:\closedbox.svg'
